# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| handover-protocol | `assets/handover-protocol.md`, filled once per use case | `metrics-scorecard`, Plant owner, reads it back on every cadence | Three-question test answered by the receiving side without asking the builder; ADKAR barrier point and evidence-of-adoption tier recorded; Acceptance result pulled from `deploy-acceptance`, not re-asked |
| definition-of-done-fields-on-the-record | Use case record | Plant owner | Output asset, business process and utilization expectation present; Data path written to the machine; Plant owner named and has used it in a real shift; Affected people told before go-live (by whom, when); Open items recorded as dependencies |
| adoption-tier | Entry in the protocol | Plant owner, DBVE | Tier no stronger than the evidence available (system usage log, named owner's dated statement, or third-party observation); Never "handover marked DONE" |
| low-utilization-action | Entry in the protocol | Plant owner, OD lead | For low or `NEVER` utilization: ADKAR diagnostic run and an action recorded (review with requester, fix at the barrier point, or retire) |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| handover-protocol | structure of `assets/handover-protocol.md` | Plant owner |
| definition-of-done-fields-on-the-record | manual | Plant owner |
| adoption-tier | manual | Plant owner |
| low-utilization-action | manual | Plant owner |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `deploy-project-order`, `deploy-migration`, `deploy-appstore`, `catalog-guardrails`, `ops-dashboard-engine`, `process-derivation`, `deploy-acceptance`, `bc-capital-request`, `funnel-use-case`
- **Next:** metrics-scorecard (reads the protocol on every cadence); a proven, repeatable result goes to catalog-standardization and catalog-usecase.: `metrics-scorecard`, `catalog-standardization`, `catalog-usecase`
- **Stops here when:** a test question cannot be answered or the plant owner is unnamed
- **Stops here when:** The handover is invalid and stays ONGOING
- **Stops here when:** never mark it DONE because delivery happened
- **Stops here when:** The plant, not OD, decides PRODUCTIVE
